title_or_table: An invented year’s budget for one parent with two children in Alder County, at earnings from $0 to $60,000
table_id: none: invented by maker B, round 1, for chapter 14’s benefit-cliff line
universe_or_base: One invented family: a parent with two children
qualification: Every value and rule is invented to show how a benefit cliff works, on the pattern of the Urban Institute’s Net Income Change Calculator; no real program, state or family is shown. The rules: taxes are 7.65 percent of earnings plus 10 percent of earnings above $30,000; tax credits phase in at 40 percent to $6,000 at $15,000, hold to $22,000 and phase out at 21 percent; food aid is $6,000 less 30 percent of earnings above $10,000; child care help is worth $9,000 while earnings are $36,000 or less and ends above that

earnings.description: the family’s earnings from work in the year, invented

taxes.description: payroll and income taxes the family pays, by the invented rules

tax_credits.description: refundable tax credits, by the invented rules

food_aid.description: food aid, by the invented rules

child_care_help.description: the value of child care help, by the invented rules

net_resources.description: earnings minus taxes plus credits, food aid and child care help
